Row 2 has an arrow pointing to a 14. Row 3 has an arrow pointing to 25. Row 4 has an arrow pointing to 36. Row 5 has an arrow pointing to 47. Row 6 has an arrow pointing to 58. Row 7 has an arrow pointing to 69. Next to rows 1 through 7 is a series of 6 curved arrows connecting the rows, starting at 3 and pointing downward from one row to the next, ending at 69. question.content:
The following pattern starts with $3$ and uses the rule *add $11$ to the previous term.*

$3, 14, 25, 36, 47, \ldots$

**Which of the following statements are true about the seventh term of the pattern?**
